verdict.rationale: NVIDIA's first-party DGX B200 user guide publishes memory capacity, but only as a system total (1,440 GB across 8 B200 GPUs). It does not state per-GPU capacity directly, and it gives no other memory specs for this part. The 14.4 TB/s figure is NVLink switch interconnect bandwidth, not memory bandwidth, so it does not count. Missing for 10: explicit per-GPU capacity, memory type (e.g. HBM generation), memory bus width, memory bandwidth, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, memory specs are published in full for this exact part — capacity, memory type, bus width, and bandwidth
